levels.title: NOT
levels.hint: Sometimes there is more than one kind of danger. Maybe we need a different way of thinking.

levels.title: Big Jump
hints: Spikes and pits are both "not ground".
Both dangers are two tiles wide.
Try: IF NOT Ground ahead, THEN Big Jump.

newItems.title: NEW ACTION: Big Jump
newItems.line: Jump clears one tile. Big Jump clears two tiles in a row.

newItems.title: NOT is now a button
newItems.line: Tap +NOT on a card to flip its condition. NOT Ground ahead is true before a pit and before a spike.

levels.title: Order
hints: At the pit, watch the pointer: which card does it stop at?
Move the Pit card to the front, so it is read first.
A normal Jump is too short for a two-tile pit: use Big Jump.

newItems.title: NEW RULE: card order
newItems.line: Cards are checked from left to right. The first card whose IF is true acts; the cards after it are not checked.

levels.title: Energy
levels.hint: One card for every danger costs too much Energy. Does every danger need a Big Jump?
hints: Watch the Energy bar: how much is left when you reach the pit?
The spike only needs a normal Jump (1 Energy).
Use the second slot: Spike -> Jump, in front of the Big Jump card.

newItems.title: NEW: Energy
newItems.line: Every jump costs Energy: Jump 1, Big Jump 3. A card without enough Energy does nothing - the runner just walks on.

levels.title: Hurdles
levels.hint: Low walls stand in the way.
hints: Watch the runner at the first wall.
A Big Jump from there lands on the next wall.
IF Wall ahead THEN Jump.
deathTimeout: Walls don't move. Something has to go over them.
Nothing can land on a wall. Count where the jump comes down.
levels.qiLine: Out of Energy. Where was that jump trying to land?
levels.previousLine: A Big Jump comes down three tiles on. Look at what stands there.

newItems.title: LOW WALL
newItems.line: Walking stops here. A Jump clears one wall, but cannot land on one.

newItems.title: NEW CARD: WALL AHEAD
newItems.line: True when a wall is right in front of the runner.

levels.title: Mind the Gap
levels.hint: Every gap says Pit ahead. Look one tile further.
hints: Pit ahead is true at every gap. What changes one tile further on?
Ground 2 ahead looks exactly where a Jump would land.
IF NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Big Jump, then IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: Each gap needs its own jump.
A Jump falls short of a wide gap. A Big Jump can overshoot a narrow one.
levels.qiLine: Out of Energy. Which gaps needed the expensive jump?
levels.previousLine: Your 1-1 card only looks for walls.

newItems.title: NEW CARD: GROUND 2 AHEAD
newItems.line: Looks two tiles ahead: exactly where a Jump lands.

levels.title: Pit Stop
levels.hint: Energy is tight on this run.
hints: Watch the Energy bar. What did the first jump fly over?
A normal Jump at the pit lands on the orb. Which danger really needs a Big Jump?
IF Spike ahead THEN Big Jump first, then IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: That pit needs a card too.
deathSpike: The wide spikes take a Big Jump from right at the edge.
Two spikes in a row. Check where that jump came down.
deathTimeout: Stuck at the wall. It needs a card too.
levels.qiLine: Out of Energy. Did you pick up the orb? Did every danger need a Big Jump?
levels.previousLine: Your 1-2 cards take off a step early here. Watch where they come down.

newItems.title: ENERGY ORB
newItems.line: Walk or land on it for +2 Energy. Fly over it and it stays behind.

levels.title: AND
solution: IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
hints: Watch the Energy: it is gone before the last pit.
Tap + AND on card 1, then pick NOT Ground 2 ahead.
IF Pit ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Big Jump, then IF Pit ahead THEN Jump.

levels.title: Both Must Hold
levels.hint: Not every pit is the same width.
solution: IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
previousSolution: IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
hints: Only one gap is two pits wide. Everything else needs just a Jump.
IF Pit ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead is true only right before the wide gap.
IF Pit ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Big Jump, then IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: Two pits in a row need a Big Jump. One pit needs only a Jump.
Check where each jump lands: a Big Jump goes one tile further.
Ground 2 ahead tells a wide gap from a narrow one.
deathSpike: A Big Jump lands one tile further than a Jump. Check what is there.
deathTimeout: Something is in the way, and no card jumps it.
levels.qiLine: Out of Energy. A Big Jump costs 3: save it for the wide gap.
levels.previousLine: Your guide cards only know pits. Something else is in the way here.

levels.title: Edge or Low Wall
solution: IF wall AND NOT ground2 THEN turn
previousSolution: IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
hints: Wall ahead is true at the edge AND at the low wall.
Ground 2 ahead tells them apart: there is nothing behind the edge.
IF Wall ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Turn, IF Pit ahead THEN Big Jump, IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: The gap was wider than the jump.
deathSpike: Something sharp was waiting where you landed.
deathTimeout: Wall ahead is true at the edge AND at the low wall.
Something is in the way, and no card gets past it.
levels.qiLine: Out of Energy. Check which card fires at the edge, and which at the low wall.

newItems.title: HIGH WALL
newItems.line: The dark wall at each end of the map. Nothing can jump it. Wall ahead is true here too.

newItems.title: NEW CARD: TURN
newItems.line: Turn makes the runner face the other way. It costs 1 Energy.

levels.title: Two Checks
levels.hint: Two places need a closer look.
solution: IF spike AND NOT ground2 THEN turn
IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
previousSolution: IF wall AND NOT ground2 THEN turn
hints: One spike is a dead end, and one gap is two pits wide.
Both can be found with NOT Ground 2 ahead: one with Spike ahead, one with Pit ahead.
IF Spike ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Turn, IF Pit ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Big Jump, IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: Check where each jump lands: a Big Jump goes one tile further.
Two pits in a row need a Big Jump. One pit needs only a Jump.
That spike had a pit behind it.
deathSpike: Every other spike needs a Jump.
deathTimeout: Something is in the way, and no card gets past it.
levels.qiLine: Out of Energy. Check which card fires at each spike and at each pit.
levels.previousLine: Your 2-2 cards only turn at walls. Here the dead end is a spike.

levels.title: Turn Around
levels.hint: The flag is behind you. Cracked ground breaks once you step off it.
previousSolution: IF spike AND NOT ground2 THEN turn
IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
hints: Sometimes forward is the wrong way.
Every cracked tile you walk over is a pit on the way back.
IF Wall ahead THEN Turn, then IF Pit ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: That was solid ground a minute ago.
deathTimeout: It's been walking into the same wall for a while now.
levels.qiLine: The orbs on the far side pay for the turn and the jumps home.
levels.previousLine: Your 2-3 cards only turn at a spike. Walls don't move.

newItems.title: NEW TILE: Cracked ground
newItems.line: Holds you while you stand on it. Step off, and it falls away into a pit.

levels.title: Double Back
levels.hint: Two cracked tiles in a row leave a double pit behind you.
solution: IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
hints: Two footprints in a row make a pit too wide for a Jump.
Big Jump only where the pit is double. AND can tell the two apart.
IF Wall ahead THEN Turn, IF Pit ahead AND NOT Ground 2 ahead THEN Big Jump, IF Pit ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: One Jump cannot clear what two footprints left.
The real pit was one tile wide. Yours is two.
deathTimeout: It's been walking into the same wall for a while now.
levels.qiLine: A Big Jump at every pit costs too much. Save it for the double one you made.
levels.previousLine: Your 3-1 cards: two footprints make a pit one Jump cannot clear.

levels.title: Trapdoor
levels.hint: The flag is on the floor below. The only way down is a hole you make yourself.
previousSolution: IF pit AND NOT ground2 THEN bigjump
hints: The flag is downstairs.
To fall through a hole, no card may jump it. Only jump what has to be jumped.
IF Wall ahead THEN Turn, then IF Spike ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: That hole had nothing under it.
deathTimeout: It jumped over the only way down.
levels.qiLine: Every Energy counts. Spend it only on what has to be jumped.
levels.previousLine: Your 3-2 cards jump every pit, including the way down.

newItems.title: NEW: Two floors
newItems.line: Walk into a hole in the upper floor and you drop to the floor below. Cards still see the hole as a pit.

levels.title: Two Floors
levels.hint: Two ways down, and only one lands safely. A hole shows you what is under it.
solution: IF NOT ground AND ground2 THEN jump
hints: One of the two holes is over the spikes.
Jump a gap only when the tile after it is ground. The double hole is the way down.
IF Wall ahead THEN Turn, then IF NOT Ground ahead AND Ground 2 ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: That hole had nothing under it.
deathSpike: Wrong hole. That one is over the spikes.
The far half of the double hole is over a spike. Walk in, don't jump in.
deathTimeout: It jumped over the only way down.
levels.qiLine: An AND card costs 1 more each time. Count before you jump.
levels.previousLine: Your 3-3 cards never jump a pit, and that hole is over the spikes.

levels.title: Bridge for Later
levels.hint: A cracked tile, a spike, then two more cracks stand between you and the Energy. The flag is downstairs.
solution: IF spike AND ground2 THEN bigjump
previousSolution: IF NOT ground AND ground2 THEN jump
hints: The far crack is your way back. Do not land on it on the way out.
Spike ahead with ground behind it only happens on the way out. On the way back, the tile behind the spike is a hole.
IF Spike ahead AND Ground 2 ahead THEN Big Jump, IF Wall ahead THEN Turn, IF NOT Ground ahead THEN Jump.
deathPit: The pit downstairs needs 1 Energy. Count what the trip costs.
deathSpike: You landed on the far crack. Coming back, there was nothing left to stand on.
Big Jump over the spike, not onto the cracks.
deathTimeout: It's been walking into the same wall for a while now.
levels.qiLine: Big Jump with AND costs 4, and you start with 4. Spend anything first and it cannot fire.
levels.previousLine: Your 3-4 cards land on the far crack, and it will not be there for the trip back.
